# `eutaxy`

`import { … } from "eutaxy";` 18 functions and values, 53 types; each links to the file that declares it.

## Functions, classes and values

### `aggregate`

`function aggregate(module: string, verdicts: readonly SpecVerdict[], reports: readonly EngineReport[]): SpecVerdict[]`

The simulator's verdicts for a module (CHECKED, TESTED, REFUTED, UNKNOWN, `total` included) combined with what the engines proved. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/prover/src/provers.ts)

### `checkedRung`

`function checkedRung(input: CheckedInput): SpecVerdict`

The `CHECKED` rung: evaluate the property on every distinct input the simulator passed the function. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/prover/src/checked.ts)

### `checkInvariant`

`function checkInvariant(log: EffectLog, inv: Invariant): Violation | null`

Check one invariant against a run's effect log; null when it holds. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/core/src/invariants.ts)

### `checkInvariants`

`function checkInvariants(log: EffectLog, invariants: readonly Invariant[]): readonly Violation[]`

Check every invariant against a run's effect log and return the violations, in the invariants' order. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/core/src/invariants.ts)

`function describeVerdict(v: ScenarioVerdict): string`

### `emitRegressionTest`

`function emitRegressionTest(verdict: Violated, options: RegressionTestOptions): string`

A Vitest test file that replays a violation's shrunk schedule: by default it fails while the bug is there and passes once it is fixed. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/report/src/regression.ts)

### `explore`

`function explore(scenario: ScenarioSpec, platform: Platform, options: ExploreOptions): Promise<ScenarioVerdict>`

Explore a scenario on a platform: run it under schedules drawn from the seed (or every schedule within the bounds, when exhaustive), shrink the first violation found, and return the verdict. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/engine/src/explore.ts)

### `observeCore`

`function observeCore(namespace: object, functions: readonly string[]): CoreObserver`

Observe the named exports of a module's namespace while runs are installed; see the module comment. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/engine/src/observe.ts)
